live.label: Drawings in progress
live.importTitle: Choose an image from your computer to add to this drawing
live.cancelTitle: Remove this draw from the list. You can start a new one any time.

empty.title: No images yet
empty.body: Draw your first illustration in Creator. Everything you draw shows up here.
empty.filteredBody: Switch to "{{all}}" to see your other images.

lightbox.label: Image
lightbox.olderHint: This image was drawn with older settings. You can still adopt it, and adopting it won't change your current settings.
lightbox.redraw: Draw again with the same request
lightbox.staleView: This was redrawn from an earlier turnaround. The turnaround has changed since, so it can't be placed in it.
lightbox.makeMainHint: The current main illustration moves to "{{previous}}". The turnaround needs splitting again, and expressions get marked as old design.
lightbox.outfitRemoved: This was drawn for an outfit that has been deleted, so it can't be adopted. Restore the outfit to use it.

refine.title: Edit an area
refine.subtitle: Drag on the image to mark what to change (or skip it to change the whole image), then describe the change.
refine.notePlaceholder: e.g. Make the buckle a brass crescent

preview.hint: Drag to move. Zoom in to check details.
